messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "trouble swallowing"
set: ["trouble swallowing", "get emergency help if having trouble swallowing", "call your doctor if you have trouble swallowing a capsule or tablet", "trouble chewing", "trouble speaking", "trouble breathing", "trouble walking", "trouble climbing", "trouble hearing", "trouble concentrating", "trouble standing", "trouble sleeping", "over-the-counter use without doctor's advice if you have trouble or pain swallowing food", "trouble lifting arms", "severe trouble sleeping", "trouble having an orgasm"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
